interpretation.unsignedByteBody: Actual direct unsigned8 field return, five typed identities/occurrences; retained enum declaration/explicit underlying association is separate from arithmetic storage. Source noexcept is null.
interpretation.pointerBody: Actual pointer-returning body retains if(integer1), pointer-local executable initialization from selected get, selected AssertNotNull(cast(bool,!ptr)), and return ptr. Retained else returns selected std operator-arrow through generated-base address/qualification operations. No branch or selected helper is replaced by class-name behavior.
interpretation.selection: Declared reference return of GetBufferRef is not an ordinary-pointer-returning target merely because its call expression has an ordinary pointer value view. Parent unsigned8 call and nested arrow are selected via exact direct target/callee/receiver relationships. Actual/formal receiver type and pointee identities remain distinct.
interpretation.order: Parent arrow call has both evaluation-order flags false. This is retained as a fact, not normalized to outer-call LTR or interpreted as a new execution schedule.
interpretation.unresolved: Three defined selected one-hop targets remain untraversed, including the assertion call with nullable noexcept. No full helper, layout, ownership, no-throw or link closure is established.

limits: Exactly two actual bodies are traced under 64 identities/256 occurrences/depth 32 each, combined 16 one-hop dependencies/64 shallow types. Parent 22 and receiver 4 selection identities are outside typed body counts.
Typed operation occurrences preserve structural aliasing; identity inventories and metadata recipes are not execution schedules. No recursive helper/layout expansion.
Completion is restricted to the declared two-body/shallow scope. The earlier accessor report remains partial for full related metadata.

Translator/Runtime/providers remain frozen at 16a07ae6b; existing modes are unchanged and retain original evidence. No source-name semantics, generated application/native fallback or closed-no-throw permission.
General pointer-return/dereference/native transport, assertion/exception helper closure, InternalException/string/allocator/link dependencies and DuckDB root execution remain open.
